bell_pepper_bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small green-yellow spots turning brown with greasy margins on leaf undersides; raised warty spots on fruit.

organic_measures.name: Copper Hydroxide Spray
organic_measures.method: Spray copper hydroxide (2 g/L) combined with neem oil emulsion.

prevention_measures: Avoid handling plants when foliage is wet.

bell_pepper_leaf_spot.symptoms: Circular leaf spots with light gray/white centers and dark brown margins resembling frog eyes.

organic_measures.name: Potassium Bicarbonate / Bio-agent Spray
organic_measures.method: Spray potassium bicarbonate (3 g/L) or Bacillus subtilis (5 ml/L).

prevention_measures: Use drip irrigation under plastic mulch.
sources: UC Davis IPM Cercospora on Pepper

bell_pepper_healthy.symptoms: Dark green glossy foliage, sturdy branching, healthy flowers and firm green/red fruit.

organic_measures.name: Balanced Organic Nutrition
organic_measures.method: Apply compost and vermicompost (2 tons/acre) with calcium foliar spray to prevent blossom end rot.

prevention_measures: Ensure consistent soil moisture to prevent fruit disorders.
Stake plants to support heavy fruit load.
